title: Nostalgi: amerikansk film och TV 1980-2009
description: Curated programme-file metadata for culturally influential US media from 1980-2009. Only actual public video files are bundled. Metadata is not a playback proof; every source still requires identity and decoded playback checks. Numbering follows source files; missing seasons remain unknown. Collection names never promise completeness.
